focus_findings.resolution: Reboot matrix now exercises an actual post-point mount failure (fixture mode 2) followed by guest reboot with module absent on the second boot; the earlier digest-rejection substitute is superseded. Host rollback test verifies only the owned directory is rolled back, stats unchanged, system/bindings/point cleared, and a subsequent successful mount works. main's rollback accounting check (used/live equality) gates the release marker and prints rollback accounting FAILED otherwise; harness forbids the FAILED marker.

trust_mount_lifetime_review.result: No new security or logic regressions found in the bounded scope.
checks: prepare_system resets the unpublished ArchiveFs on every preflight error before the static borrow can be published; success path performs only infallible publication (no second raw alias, no destruction under guards).
mount_backend/mount_rosti reject nonempty /mnt/rosti and non-directory roots; failed attach rolls back only directories created by that call; corrupt disk never formatted.

Mount bindings are generation-checked (slot+generation); stale bindings and exhausted generations (u32::MAX) are retired, never aliased; unmount blocks while cwd or any open descriptor pins disk nodes and bumps all generations on detach.
fd table: default-deny rights, snapshot-then-mutate bound() avoids overlapping borrows, offset advances only by delivered bytes; provisional generation undone on allocation failure.
/system archive is read-only across all mutator commands (verified by tests and saved GRUB shell reports); system_info accounts archive/routing separately from RAMFS.
Trust path verifies digest against system_image::EXPECTED_SHA256 before any VFS node construction; rejected inventory closes the storage gate before any device probe.
No new unsafe added in source helpers this cycle (only the pre-existing &raw static patterns and the B26 test extern crate alloc).
